title: Bitcoin didn't get the memo everyone else in tech got. While Nvidia, Intel and AMD all slid after Anthropic's CEO called for the AI industry to slow down (with Sam Altman and Elon Musk backing him), bitcoin climbed close to its September record. Momentum behind a crypto bill in the Senate is giving it an extra push. Do you think bitcoin keeps decoupling from tech, or does it eventually follow chip stocks down? Read more at link in bio.
